fields.name: Asha Banks
fields.biography:
Asha Banks is a young British actress and singer based in London.

Asha has extensive theatre credits, and has a lead part in her first feature film, The Magic Flute, released in November 2022. The film is a modern retelling of Mozart's popular opera, produced by Roland Emmerich's Centropolis Entertainment and Flute Film, and directed by Florian Sigl. Asha plays the female lead part of Princess Pamina. The movie also stars Iwan Rheon and Jack Wolfe and some of the world's most renowned opera stars.

Asha recently played the part of Thea in London's 2021/22 critically acclaimed Olivier-nominated production of Spring Awakening at the Almeida Theatre directed by Rupert Goold. She was also the understudy for the lead role of Wendla and performed as Wendla a number of times.

Asha made her professional acting debut at the age of 8 years old in the London West End show Les Miserables (at the Queen's Theatre, now the Sondheim Theatre). Since then she has played principal parts in a further six West End and UK productions.

Asha worked for the Royal Shakespeare Company (RSC) in 2019/20, when she portrayed the lead part of Lisa James in their musical production of David Walliams' The Boy in the Dress, at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre in Stratford-upon-Avon directed by Gregory Doran, with a book by Mark Ravenhill, and music from pop partnership Robbie Williams and Guy Chambers. Asha sings Lisa James' main musical ballad 'When Things Fall Apart" on the original cast album of the musical, released in 2020.

Prior to this, Asha has played parts such as Violet Beauregarde in Charlie & The Chocolate Factory at the Theatre Royal Drury Lane, Duffy in the UK tour of Annie the Musical directed by Nikolai Foster, and the Parsons Girl in the multi-award-winning and Olivier-nominated play 1984, directed by Robert Icke and Duncan Macmillan for the Almeida theatre, which then transferred to the Playhouse theatre, London, taking Asha with it.

Asha also portrayed Pandora Braithwaite in The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole, aged 13 ¾ at the Menier Chocolate Factory, London, for which she earned outstanding reviews. "Asha Banks gives a stellar performance" said The Times, and "Asha Banks on press night - very funny and a cracking singer, surely a future star" from London Timeout magazine while The Telegraph said she was "the perfect mix of poise, aloofness and vitality" and The Times called her performance "outstanding".

fields.name: Andrew Lary
fields.biography:
Andrew Lary is a Partner and Executive Managing Director at Domain Capital, where he serves on the leadership team for the Media, Entertainment, and Technology (MET) business.

Since joining Domain in 2011, Andrew has been a key force in the firm’s exponential growth, with assets under management rising from $1.2 billion to nearly $8 billion. He spearheaded the expansion of the business beyond its real estate roots into the MET sector, co-leading the origination of $1.5 billion in investments, including $800 million in entertainment assets. In 2020, he was instrumental in launching the firm’s Entertainment fund, which successfully secured over $700 million in investor commitments.

Andrew began his career in 1995 with PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), where he advanced to Senior Manager in the Real Estate Business Advisory Services division over the course of eight years. There, he provided strategic management and consultative services to major financial institutions. In 2003, he continued this work through Sandusky Capital, a firm he cofounded.

He holds a B.S.M. in Accounting from Tulane University and is a Certified Public Accountant licensed in New York (inactive). In addition to his professional responsibilities, Andrew serves on numerous advisory boards on behalf of Domain’s clients.

fields.name: Anthony Tittanegro
fields.biography:
Anthony Tittanegro is a Partner and Executive Managing Director at Domain Capital.

He joined Domain in 2010. Before his tenure at Domain, Anthony founded and operated Titan Property Group, a boutique real estate investment and development firm. He also spent 11 years with PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) in their Real Estate Advisory practice, and six years in service with Prudential.

In addition to his professional pursuits, Anthony is a member of the Counsellors of Real Estate Organisation and serves on the Board of Directors of Midcap Financial, a speciality finance company with approximately $40 billion in assets under management. He completed his B.S. in Business Finance at the Florida Institute of Technology. He earned his master’s degree from New York University.

fields.name: Juliano Krue Valdi
fields.biography: Juliano Valdi (born 2 February 2014) is an American actor, known for Michael (2026), The Loud House (2015) and Arco (2025).

fields.name: Chelsea Brown
fields.biography:
Chelsea Brown is an Australian actress who grew up in Sydney, Australia as the precocious oldest child of six, with a keen fascination for film and stories. A commercial actor at two years old, she later became a youth ambassador for Sydney's Griffin Theatre Company during high school. Graduating dux of her year, Chelsea took a break from her acting ambitions to study law and writing, and to travel the world. She returned to her creative passion in her final years of university, before studying full time at the International Screen Academy, Sydney.

Chelsea has been working as an actor in the Australian industry for a number of years since, in both local and US productions. She can be seen in Shine’s miniseries ‘Peter Allen, Not The Boy Next Door’, as well as the Australian independent film ‘Mindset’ currently touring the international festival circuit. She also writes and works as a photographer in Vancouver, Canada.

fields.name: Sabina Tenorio
fields.biography: Rising Mexican actress, writer, dancer, and producer, Sabina Tenorio started her acting career when she was 6 years old. Since then, she continued her training as an artist, both in Mexico City and Los Angeles. She recently graduated from BFA Acting for Film having honorary awards. She has performed memorable roles in theater such as Sonya from Uncle Vanya, Laura from The Glass Menagerie and Police in The Seagull. Most recently and notably, she created "Luz" A short film, now a movie in development about what it is to grow up as a woman in Mexico. The movie celebrates art, feminism and Mexican folklore. Some of her upcoming projects are "Dale a Tu Cuerpo Alegría" where she plays Susana, a control freak, and "Cranberry Pie" where she plays Ly, a woman in an abusive relationship who's just had an abortion.

fields.name: Riley Barker
fields.biography: Riley Barker is an American cinematographer known for his work on the sketch series That’s a Bad Idea. He also lensed the short film Warnings, written and directed by Curry Barker. In addition to these projects, Barker has shot a range of independent short films, developing a reputation for versatility, strong visual storytelling, and creative precision.

fields.name: Priya Jain
fields.biography: Priya Jain is an American film actress of Indian descent born in Orange County, California. She portrays a U.S. Coast Guard lieutenant opposite Josh Duhamel in writer/director Joe Carnahan's thriller Not Without Hope, starring Zachary Levi. She also plays the role of Sam in director Vaughn Stein's survival thriller The Canyon. In addition, Priya has secured the financing and is a producer on The Canyon. Priya gets a chance to showcase her fighting skills in the TV mini-series Knock Out, and she also plays a flight attendant in director Renny Harlin's thriller Deep Water, starring Aaron Eckhart and Ben Kingsley. An Orange County, California native, Priya began her career as a fashion model, an occupation that also became entrepreneurial when she started her own clothing line - Naked Lynx. Naked Lynx has been featured in several fashion magazines, articles, and has been seen on celebrities and influencers. After receiving initial acting training with the Upright Citizens Brigade, Lesly Khan, Killian, and Judy Kain, she made her film debut in 2017 as Mariam in director Mike Hermos's action/mystery/drama Wildflower. In the same year, she also portrayed a dancer in Dr. Dre's series Vital Signs for Apple TV. Moving to New York in 2019, Priya continued her actor training while also modeling and engaging in intensive stage fighting. In 2020 she started her clothing line Naked Lynx which is still manufactured and sold out of the New York City garment district. Returning to California in 2023 she emerged back into acting when she filmed Not Without Hope, Deep Water and The Canyon all in 2023. She also took the role of Natalie in writer/director/star Caylee Cowan's drama short, Running to Stand Still. While juggling her career as an actress, Priya manages to keep her clothing line thriving and hone her impressive mixed martial arts abilities.

fields.name: Alun Cummins
fields.biography:
Alun Cummins is a visual effects producer at Industrial Light & Magic. He began his career working on-set as a production assistant for commercials in Vancouver before transitioning into visual effects. Holding a Bachelor's degree in English Literature from Leeds Beckett University, he embarked on a path that would lead him to become a respected figure in TV visual effects production.

He then spent about four years at Double Negative, working in both London and Vancouver. During his time there, he served in roles such as VFX line producer and VFX production coordinator on various television projects, including Electric Dreams (2017–2018), The Young Pope (2016), Outcast (2017), and Fungus the Bogeyman (2015).

In 2019, Cummins began working at Industrial Light & Magic (ILM). His first assignment was The Underground Railroad as a Visual Effects Producer (2021). Over the following years at ILM, he produced visual effects for several prominent projects, including Lost Ollie (2022), The Witcher Season 1 (2021), Ultraman: Rising (2024), and Sinners (2025).

Earlier in his career, Cummins received industry recognition for his work on the Hulu miniseries Catch-22 (2019), where he served as Visual Effects Producer (for DNEG TV). He and his team—including Matt Kasmir, Brian Connor, Dan Charbit, Matthew Wheelon Hunt, Gavin Harrison, Giovanni Casadei, Remi Martin, and Peter Farkas—were nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 2019 for Outstanding Special Visual Effects in a Supporting Role for their work on season 1 episode 4.

fields.name: Courtney Grace
fields.biography: Courtney Grace is an American actress and former television reporter, producer, and anchor.

fields.name: Tony Zhou
fields.biography: Tony Zhou is a New Zealand actor known for portraying coming-of-age, eccentric, boyish, and unhinged characters across drama and comedy. He has appeared in television series such as The Eggplant (2020), Shortland Street (1992), and Camp Be Better (2024), as well as the independent comedy feature The Red Admiral (2025). Tony has also led critically acclaimed short films, including Cherry (2022), Illuminati Castrati (2024), and Baked for Christmas (2024), which have screened at local and international festivals such as LA Shorts, NZ Web Fest, and the South Film and Arts Academy Festival (SFAAF).

fields.name: Sai Abhyankkar
fields.biography: Sai Abhyankkar (born on 4 November 2004) is an Indian composer, playback singer and music producer who works primarily in Tamil cinema. Sai grew up immersed in music and trained in both vocals and instruments like keyboards, drums, and tabla. He broke through with the independent singles Katchi Sera (2024) and Aasa Kooda (2024) which were huge hits and helped cement his reputation as a fresh voice in the Tamil indie music scene.

fields.name: Aaron Folbe
fields.biography: Aaron Folbe is a manager and producer at Underground production company.

fields.name: Tomasz Wachnik
fields.biography: Tomasz Wachnik is a visual effects producer at Industrial Light & Magic (ILM).

fields.name: Scarlett Spears
fields.biography: Scarlett Brielle Spears (born June 12, 2017) is an American child actress. She is best known for playing Donna Corinthos in the soap opera General Hospital since 2022, and Young Glinda in the 2025 film Wicked: For Good.

fields.name: Chloe Breen
fields.biography:
Chloe Breen started acting at the young age of four after being cast in a local commercial for a community hospital. Since then, it has been her passion and her dream to entertain, enchant, enlighten, and make people laugh. Chloe respects the profession, at all levels, and right out of college, she worked as a PA on the film Down Low and worked closely with the cast, directors, producers and staff. Learning the business from behind the scenes right out of the gate gave Chloe a greater respect for all that goes into the making of a film.

More recently, Chloe has been cast in several horror/thriller films, where she has unfurled a new skill-set. Chloe has also been able to pivot quickly between roles and recently was cast as a lead in an independent Christmas comedy film. Bringing all her skills together, Chloe also landed a role in The Mask Reboot. Chloe feels blessed to be part of an industry that is evolving constantly and is eager to share her talent with the world. She credits her successes to date to her unflappable and incredible family who has supported and inspired her dream from the start.
